_uitleg: De campagne: de proloog (id 0) en tien levels, naar claude/campagne-verhaal.md in het project. Alle tekst die de speler ziet is Engels.

heer: de naam van de tegenstander (de rode koning is de heer zelf). portret: bestand in beelden/portretten. profiel: uit missies.json. kaart: uit kaarten.json. punt: plek op de levelkaart in procenten van het schilderij (beelden/levelkaart.webp); de weg en de brug staan in data/levelkaart.json.
speelbaar: false zolang het level nog niet gebouwd is; het staat dan op de kaart als 'coming later'.

beloning: soldaten en gebouwen die je krijgt als je dit level wint, zoveel mogelijk iets van de heer die je versloeg. In een level heb je de beloningen van alle levels ervoor. Wat in geen enkele beloning staat, heb je altijd (ridder, boogschutter, de economie, kazerne, muren).
beloningLater: ideeen voor soldaten die nog niet bestaan (alleen voor ons, het spel leest dit niet).
intro en uit: de korte tekst voor en na het level. wessel: het voorwerp van Wessel dat je na het winnen vindt.
figuren: wie er praat in de briefing en de verhaalbalk (naam en portret). verteller: wie de briefing vertelt (standaard bartholt).

berichten: wat figuren zeggen tijdens het level. bij = tijd (seconden), aanval (nummer), burcht, koning, roodBurcht, roodKoning (onder dit percentage leven). wie = een figuur of heer. portret mag een andere uitdrukking kiezen. Hooguit 40 woorden. berichtenAltijd geldt in elk level.

rood (stap 32): hoe de heer van dit level speelt, bovenop het profiel. sterkte en tempo in procenten (100 = zoals het profiel), eersteAanval in seconden, leger = zijn legermengsel (aandeel en vanaf welke aanval), wachters = mannen die thuisblijven. koning.leven in procenten van de gewone koning; koning.uiterlijk = tabbaard (kleur kleding), wapen (kleur embleem), wapenSoort (zwaard, speer, hellebaard, haak, hamer, moker, boog, scepter), schild, haar, baard (geen = zonder), vlecht. De mantel blijft rood: dat is het team.

berichtenAltijd.tekst: Our keep is taking a beating, my king. Send soldiers home before the walls give way.
Your Majesty, you are wounded! Pull back behind your men. If you fall, all is lost.
Not yet. Not before I have my son back.

levels.intro: Wessel turns nine. Bartholt teaches you to build and to train soldiers. That night the gate opens from the inside.
Witherheath is the first stop on the road north. Only yesterday Reinout sat at Wessel's table. Defeat him and ask him where your son is.
levels.uit: Reinout surrenders. Ottger let him keep his land in exchange for the betrayal. The boy was taken north unharmed. Reinout hands over the copper veins of the heath that he mined for the duke.
levels.wessel: A wooden horse, carefully laid on a cushion in Reinout's tent.

berichten.tekst: Reinout's workshops stand outside his wall. Burn them and his army goes hungry.
Forgive me, Karel. I had no choice. Turn back while you still can.
His walls are crumbling. Push on!
Enough! I only wanted to keep my land. Ask me anything, I will answer.

levels.intro: There is only one road north, and it runs through Lady Mechteld's pass. Her archers are the best in the land.
levels.uit: Mechteld: "Nobody told me there was a child involved." She lets you pass, but promises no support yet. A few of her marksmen join you and bring the crossbow.
levels.wessel: A charcoal drawing of the wind on the wall of the guardroom.

berichten.tekst: Mechteld's archers hold the high ground. Build a copper mine: copper sells well, and gold buys soldiers.
Nobody passes Sevenwinds without my leave, King Karel. Not even you.
You fight like a man with something to lose.
Wait. Why does a king march north with so few men?

levels.intro: Hademar sells weapons to whoever pays, and Ottger paid well. His mining town has double walls and early battering rams.
levels.uit: Hademar buys his freedom with the plan of Mournkeep: three rings, and a tower on the east side where nobody goes. His smiths now forge axes and catapults for you.
levels.wessel: A small gauntlet, forged to fit. A gift from the duke for a boy he had never met.

berichten.tekst: Hademar's town has double walls and heavy knights. Our crossbows will pierce their armour.
Everything has a price, Karel. Even a boy. Shall we talk business?
I do not bargain for my son. Break the gate.
Stop! I can give you something worth more than gold: the plan of Mournkeep.

levels.intro: In the marsh stands Mother Gesina's hut. She needs eight minutes to call the Silent Folk. Hold the hut.
levels.wessel: The first letter: "I am not afraid. Everything here is very big."

levels.intro: Aleid holds the abbey of the Order of the White Banner, and keeps Brother Ludolf prisoner.
levels.wessel: His name in the abbey guestbook, in a child's handwriting.

levels.intro: On the bare ridge Lambrecht builds Ottger's machines. Destroy his two workshops.
levels.wessel: A wooden battering ram the size of two hands.

levels.intro: The tollhouse closes the only road with three gates, one behind the other.
levels.wessel: A letter to his father: "Grandpa is old. He cries when he thinks I am asleep."

levels.intro: Behind the dike lies low land. A stone sluice keeps the red keep dry and within reach.
levels.wessel: A little sailing boat made of bark, found in the reeds.

levels.intro: A great mountain fort closes the last road to Blackmark. Falconer leads the Mourning Guard.
levels.wessel: A drawing of two banners side by side.

levels.intro: Three rings, and the Raven Tower on the east side, where Wessel is kept.
